LanguageData.PD_IntroText:
When you hold an eligible prisoner, their originating faction may contact you with a ransom offer after several days.

Build and power a comms console to negotiate immediately and set your own ransom demand. You can also wait for the faction to make the first offer.

Note: This explanation appears only once. Future prisoners still use this system, but this message will not appear again.
